title: Panic 0x20000 / compass family
symptoms: panic 0x20000 compass sensor reset or repeated sensor-related panic
patterns: 0x20000 compass sensor I2C sensor array reset
next_step: Compare the affected sensor bus against a known-good board and verify power plus SDA/SCL continuity before replacing the sensor.

title: I2C communication failure
symptoms: I2C timeout missing device SDA SCL communication error
patterns: I2C SDA SCL timeout address missing
diagnosis: I2C bus or device communication fault
next_step: Check pull-ups, rail voltage, SDA/SCL continuity, bus activity and the expected device address against a known-good board.

title: Wireless ADB local connection
next_step: Verify Wireless Debugging is ON, discover the correct mDNS endpoint, then connect through the local loopback endpoint.
